abstract: Two diploid embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell lines, P10 and P19, differ in their response to the embryonic environment. P10 produces mostly normal chimeras following injection into blastocysts, whereas P19 produces mostly abnormal chimeras. In this study, P10 cells were aggregated with morulae, and all resulting fetuses were chimeric with very large contributions from the EC cells. However, all embryos were abnormal. Following aggregation of P19 cells with morulae, very few embryos were recovered and they were all non-chimeric. Both P10 and P19 were capable of forming functional gap junctions with morula cells and with the ICM of the blastocyst but not with trophoblast, showing that differences in the ability to make junctional contact with the embryo cannot explain the differences between the two cell lines.
abstract_ja: 二倍体胎児性癌(EC)細胞株P10とP19は、胚の環境に対する反応が異なる。P10は胚盤胞への注入後、ほとんどが正常なキメラを生じるが、P19はほとんどが異常なキメラを生じる。本研究では、P10細胞を桑実胚と凝集させたところ、得られた胎児はすべてEC細胞の寄与が非常に大きいキメラであった。しかし、胚はすべて異常であった。P19細胞を桑実胚と凝集させた場合、回収された胚は非常に少なく、すべてキメラではなかった。P10とP19はいずれも、桑実胚細胞および胚盤胞の内細胞塊と機能的なギャップ結合を形成できたが、栄養外胚葉とは形成しなかった。このことから、両細胞株の違いは、胚との接合部形成能の差では説明できない。
